name: Create Password Durable User
summary: Creates the canonical durable user after all password registration proofs are complete.

sourceState.expression: pending-identity-status == resolution-required and pending-identity-flow == password and email-ownership == verified and profile-completeness == complete and credential-proof == password-proved and durable-identity == creation-required and account-status == absent and home-workspace == not-applicable

guards.expression: input.pending-identity-reference resolves to the active PendingIdentity and no canonical duplicate exists
